data_juicer.grouping: native hash equality; official compute_hash for every record including repeated image paths

semhash.grouping: native filtered exact and similarity relations unioned; preserve native selected/filtered

semdedup.implementation: GRAPH_SURFACES_RUN kmeans + all within-cell cosine>=0.995 pairs CC

evaluation.method: GRAPH_SURFACES_RUN pairwise integer contingency; global graph then project endpoints; ungrouped singleton
evaluation.original_gate: 50000 global nodes; M-excluded test 5998 records / 17985003 pairs / 8701 positives
evaluation.alignment: new components in corpus/input row order with record_ids sidecar; cached COCO_SCALE_RUN/SOP_SCALE_RUN components in lexicographically sorted record_id order
evaluation.deletion_semantics: hypothetical n-clusters, not a semantic deletion authorization or enacted export

gates.comparison: independently computed integer counts where supplied; F1 rounded to six decimals equals supplied budget; stop on any mismatch

cost.execution: fresh single process per corpus/method; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty; no gpu.lock
cost.measurement: perf_counter wall, process_time CPU, resource.ru_maxrss KiB lifetime process peak; phases read/index_or_cluster/dedup/write separately; evaluation separate
cost.stage_a: all new methods reuse frozen embeddings; DJ image decode+pHash included; caption MinHash hash calculation included
cost.historical: B stage plus CD stage wall for existing pipeline scope; max stage RSS, never sum RSS; whole CD includes more than selected method and is explicitly labeled
cost.budget: after gates run SOP four methods once; extrapolate method read/index/dedup/write by COCO/SOP record ratio; stop if gate locked time + SOP actual + projected COCO + evaluation exceeds 14400 seconds; preserve failures and receipts
